fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including allegations of corruption and graft, high property tax assessments, and criticism of public-utility contracts and rates. Reports and opinion pieces address Miami Beach transportation and a proposed agreement affecting jitney service, and call for repair of the Baker's Haulover bridge. Additional items cover policing and court practices (including costs assessed to discharged defendants), hunting restrictions affecting Seminole Indians, Miami airport planning and municipal contracting, and a satirical account related to Prohibition enforcement in the Everglades. The issue also contains society/column items, advertisements, and entertainment and sports notices.
